text: True or False: Germanium is integrated into the silicon photonics platform mainly to provide efficient photodetection at 1550 nm, because silicon itself is transparent (non-absorbing) at that wavelength.
explanation: True. Silicon's transparency at 1550 nm, the very property that makes it a good waveguide, means it cannot detect that light, so epitaxial germanium is added for photodetection. This extra epitaxial step is one of silicon photonics' engineering costs.
